common_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one finished text-free source-art panel for an original premium vertical-scroll action manhwa. Preserve the registered original adult character, costume, equipment, creature, and Ember Vault contracts from the supplied fresh isolated reference sheets. Original clean modern action-anime/manhwa language: crisp tapered charcoal contour, confident silhouette, simplified mature faces, controlled two-step cel shading, matte shapes, foreground/midground/background separation, restrained charcoal/ivory/teal/brass palette and only one localized ember-orange accent. One narrative moment, phone-first focal hierarchy, practical non-sexualized adults. No text, letters, digits, fake glyphs, speech balloons, captions, cards, UI, watermark, logo, signature, frame grid, collage, child-coded face, painterly fantasy, glossy 3D, crosshatching, grunge, decorative clutter, blanket particles, gore, named-title imitation, or living-artist imitation.

cases.beat: Elian hears the Bell Regent below and chooses to stay; tight mature close-up, jaw tense, green eyes tracking downward, quiet charcoal negative space upper left.
Mira decides not to order Elian away; freckled face softens without losing command, split shield edge at frame right, open space upper right.
Elian sits against one bridge anchor holding a cracked rib while Mira kneels at arm's length, anger masking fear; hands visible, restrained eye contact, open center-top.
Elian and Mira stand full-body back-to-back on a narrow chain bridge; every garment, belt capsule, hookblade, spear, shield strap, hand and boot readable.
Extreme close-up: Mira's left forearm locks the split shield hinge while her right hand adjusts spear grip; five fingers each, plausible wrist and hardware interaction, open upper-left field.

Elian, Mira, Orin and Sable share one tense platform; four distinct mature adult silhouettes and eyelines, no duplicated faces, open top band. Elian and Mira remain exact. Orin Pell is a broad compact 41-year-old light-olive forge-medic with graying dark hair, short boxed beard and rust-red apron. Sable Renn is a wiry 35-year-old fair cool-complexioned woman with amber eyes, black undercut, silver temple streak, fitted black-plum coat and segmented straight saber.
Vertical Ember Vault establishing view: tiny Elian and Mira cross one suspended chain bridge toward the sealed bell lift amid fired-clay ribs and geothermal depth; three clear depth planes.
Low camera looks up the Hollow Meridian crownshaft through repeating fired-clay ribs, black lift cable and two distant platforms; one tiny adult silhouette establishes scale, clean vanishing point.
Belljaw Warden emerges side-on from behind a kiln rib, iconic ivory shell, four black articulated forelimbs and bell jaw seam clearly readable, open upper-right field.
The towering Bell Regent climbs a vertical cable far below the city lift; original hollow bell torso, four long jointed legs and crown yoke, monumental but spatially clear.
Elian performs one low Fault Step left-to-right beneath Belljaw's jaw, hookblade aligned to the orange ankle seam; extreme foreshortening only along movement vector, grip and feet plausible.
Wide side view establishes the chain bridge: Belljaw at right charges left, Mira anchors center-left, Elian waits behind her, one intact anchor behind Elian; vectors unmistakable.
Belljaw clamps Mira's spear shaft and twists clockwise; Mira's planted boots slide but her shield stays between jaw and torso; clear physical contact and torque.
Elian crouches behind Mira and activates Fault Sight; exactly one hairline orange fault appears across Belljaw's front ankle, his gaze and free hand point to it.
Belljaw's forelimb backhands Elian into one hanging chain; impact bends his torso around the chain, hookblade remains in right hand, coat tears at left rib.
Immediate consequence: Elian on one knee grips his left rib, Mira still holds the jaw direction in deep background, intact anchor and fault line remain in their established places.
Payoff: Mira redirects Belljaw upward with shield and spear as Elian accelerates bottom-left to top-right and strikes the ankle seam; one clean converging impact, ceramic plate breaks away.
After the fight, Elian's coat is torn at the same left rib and his posture protects that side; Mira's spear is scuffed but straight, Belljaw ankle plate lies behind them.
Mira offers Elian a hand up; he looks at the hand before accepting, no smile, simple teal-black gradient and one out-of-focus chain, generous balloon space above.
Elian in three-quarter profile steadies his breathing against a plain kiln wall; large clean negative-space field at upper left for compact Status, XP and Level UI.
Elian studies the hookblade while one verified orange fault reflection crosses its edge; uncluttered negative space at right for Skill and Quest cards.
Top-down view of Elian's belt and open gloved palm holding one brass Cinder-Key; six physical slot tabs visible but blank, clean left field for deterministic Item and Inventory UI.
Elian exhales two deliberate ember pulses at his collarbone while Belljaw silhouette waits far across the bridge; negative upper band for Enemy and Cultivation interface.

Belljaw collapses beside the intact anchor while Elian and Mira remain readable at foreground left; controlled debris and three depth planes, reserve two separate quiet corners for dense but safe reconciliation UI.
